card.name: Commas between section numbers in citations
card.fires_on: The comma separating two section numbers inside a parenthetical cross-reference, such as ( 2.5, 7.1 ), in the highlights of a drug label. A stray digit in an old scanned text also fires it weakly.

modes.label: Section-number commas
modes.description: A comma after a decimal section number in a parenthesis at the end of a highlights bullet.
modes.example: Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors: Avoid coadministration. If unavoidable, reduce BRAFTOVI dosage. ( 2.6<< ,>> 7.1 )

modes.label: Digit in old scanned text
modes.description: A single digit in garbled historical text, the strongest case but a one-off.
modes.example: . Feb. 28.—Vote on Corwin's report from th* committee of 33 :—the resolutions-adopted—l<<3>>f March I.—General Twiggs
